items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: this fellow from Europe really admired Bill's work... THIS ADMIRER picked it up and made a big blast

ctx.x: So we always had our own bottles upstairs anyhow, playing cards and, you know, take -- you know, you could relax, but it was still four flights upstairs, walking, uncomfortable quarters. So this fellow -- this fellow from Europe really admired Bill's work. And I was playing with the Golden Gate Quartet, which you could hear a pin drop. They

added a bass to the quartet, and I went on with the M- between sets, between our sets. And Bill had to go to the men's room, and he left his horn on the bar, and THIS ADMIRER picked it up and made a big blast -- toot.
